?token: Control token of the UNO Control App: in the Control App, ? → API Description, the part of the address between /controlapps/ and /api. It is not the output URL used in OBS. It is saved only in this key.
?reload: Connects to UNO with the token and reloads overlays, fields and slots.
?confirmSeconds: Protection against an accidental press. The first press arms the key (it blinks) and only a second press within the chosen time runs it. "Off" runs on the first press.
?autoClose: After showing the overlay, hides it by itself after the chosen time. The key shows the countdown in a red badge. "Disabled" does not hide.
?delay: Shows the overlay first and writes the new value only after the chosen time; presses in that interval add up.
?channel: Links this knob to a Visor key of the same channel, which shows the slot or value the knob is choosing. "None" turns it off.
?shiftOverlayId: Overlay the knob uses while a Shift key is held. Empty uses the usual one.
?shiftFieldComposite: Field the knob uses while a Shift key is held. Empty uses the usual one.
?overlayId: Overlay of the Control App. The list has search and favorites (★).
?fieldComposite: Field of the overlay that the action reads or writes. Only fields of the expected type are listed.
?tokens: More control apps that the same press also reaches, one after the other in the global queue. If one fails, the others still run; the key alerts and the log names the app (never the token). Each app counts toward its own daily UNO quota.
?showall: Press to show all overlays of the control apps of this key (the API Token and the optional list below).
?hideall: Press to hide all overlays of the control apps of this key (the API Token and the optional list below).
?toggle: Edits are saved to UNO automatically. A selected server slot is saved before Take. Normal mode toggles visibility; Slot mode always shows. Triggers and chains are on the settings page (Plugins → UNO Overlays → gear) and work even when this key is not on screen.
?toggle.pressAgain: What a new press does while the Auto Close countdown runs: "Hide now" hides at once; "Add the Auto Close time" adds one more Auto Close.
?toggle.slotNumber: Server slot that the key takes before showing. Empty (live / current slot) uses the current content of the overlay.
?toggle.slotsEnabled: "Normal toggle" alternates between show and hide; "Always show (Slots)" always takes the chosen slot and shows.
?toggle.slotName: Creates, renames or removes server slots of this overlay with the buttons below.
?toggle.form: Content of the overlay, from its UNO model. Each change is saved to UNO; while the overlay is on air, the plugin waits until you stop typing (Edits while on air).
?toggle.group: Overlays with the same group name are never on air together: showing one hides the others, also when their keys are not on screen. The group time and its members are on the settings page.
?toggle.liveEdits: While this overlay is on air, an edit is sent only after a pause without changes, so the audience never sees half a word. Closing the inspector, moving to another field, pressing a key or Panic send at once.
?toggle.liveEditDelay: Pause without changes before an on-air edit is sent, in milliseconds (0 to 10 000). Empty uses the value of the settings page (1000 by default).
?toggle.triggers: Triggers (OBS scene, streaming, recording) and chains (when this overlay goes on or off air) moved to the settings page, so they run whatever profile or device is on screen. Triggers of keys from version 1.0 move there by themselves when the key appears once.
?toggle.obsOnlyScenes: Protection: the key shows the overlay only while the OBS program scene is one of these (comma-separated); in other scenes the key only alerts.
?knob: Configure each gesture independently. Numeric operations use the global multiplier for every tick.
?knob.action: An independent action for each gesture of the knob: toggle an overlay, show all, hide all, increment or decrement a field.
?knob.autoClose: After showing the overlay, hides it by itself after the chosen time. "Disabled" does not hide.
?numericfields: Press uses the selected operation. Clockwise increases; counterclockwise decreases. Each tick uses the global multiplier, or the fixed step when set. The key shows what one press adds (+3, −5). Delay shows the overlay before updating.
?numericfields.operation: "Increment (+)" adds, "Decrement (−)" subtracts. On a knob, the direction of the turn decides.
?numericfields.step: How much each press or knob tick adds or subtracts. Empty uses the global multiplier, and the key shows the multiplier in use.
?numericfields.min: Lowest value. On reaching it, the key alerts and does not go below.
?numericfields.max: Highest value. On reaching it, the key alerts and does not go above.
?numericfields.modelLimits: "Apply" also uses the limits set in the overlay model, like the official UNO client.
?numericfields.pointOverlayId: After each point, shows another overlay (for example a "point!" graphic) for the chosen time.
?numericfields.pointSeconds: How long the overlay shown after a point stays on air.
?multiplier: Press sets the global multiplier. Rotation adjusts it from 1 to 50. No API token is needed.
?multiplier.multiplier: Global multiplier, from 1 to 50, used by Numeric Fields, Knob Control and Dial Value when there is no fixed step.
?display: Follows the live numeric field through the UNO realtime connection, including changes made on the website. Pressing does nothing.
?display.fieldComposite: Field whose value the key shows live, including changes made on the UNO website.
?nextslot: Takes the next server slot (TakeOverlayNextSlot) and shows the overlay. Red while the overlay is on air.
?prevslot: Takes the previous server slot (TakeOverlayPreviousSlot) and shows the overlay. Red while the overlay is on air.
?nextslot.overlayId: Overlay whose server slots are stepped through.
?prevslot.overlayId: Overlay whose server slots are stepped through.
?slotwheel: Action Wheel: turn to choose a slot (shown on the Visor key of the same channel), click to take it and show the overlay. Optional carousel: each turn takes the next or previous slot on air.
?slotwheel.overlayId: Overlay whose server slots the wheel goes through.
?slotwheel.carousel: "Chooses a slot" (default): turning only chooses and the Visor shows it; pressing takes it and shows the overlay. "Carousel": each turn takes the next or previous slot and the overlay changes on air; pressing shows or hides it. Fast turns become one take at most every 0.3 s.
?reveal: Quiz: press to reveal or hide the answer of the slot on air. Red while revealed. A new slot on air hides it again, also when this key is not on screen.
?reveal.fieldComposite: Field of the overlay that shows or hides the answer (for example a checkbox "Show answer").
?reveal.shownValue: Value written when revealing. For a checkbox: true. For a text field: the text that reveals.
?reveal.hiddenValue: Value written when hiding. For a checkbox: false. For a text field: empty or the text that hides.
?reveal.highlight: Optional: while revealed, copies the correct answer into another field (for example the field that highlights an option). Hiding empties it.
?reveal.copyFrom: Field that holds the correct answer of the slot on air.
?reveal.copyTo: Field that receives the correct answer while it is revealed.
?dialvalue: uno v2 dial: click to enter edit mode, turn to choose the value (global multiplier per tick), click to send once. Hold 2 s to cancel.
?dialvalue.fieldComposite: Press to edit, turn to choose the value (multiplier per tick), press to send. Holding 2 s cancels.
?visor: Shows the slot or value of the knob on the same channel. Pressing it (or a screenless button with this action) clicks that knob. Works only while the knob is on screen too.
?visor.channel: Channel of the knob whose state this key shows; pressing equals pressing the knob.
?timer: Controls a timer (timecontrol) field like the official client: Play, Pause, Reset, Start, or Play/Pause. Red while running.
?timer.operation: Play/Pause, Play, Pause, Reset or Start (from zero), as in the official client.
?obsscene: Switches the OBS program scene, then optionally shows an overlay. Red while that scene is on program.
?obsscene.overlayId: Overlay shown after the switch, with optional Auto Close.
?obsrefresh: Presses "Refresh cache of current page" (refreshnocache) on OBS browser sources, one after the other; one that fails does not stop the others.
?obsrefresh.refreshMode: Refresh the browser sources chosen here, or every browser source of a scene, including its groups and nested scenes.
?obsrefresh.refreshScene: Scene whose browser sources are all refreshed.
?obsrefresh.inputName: Browser source of OBS reloaded without cache.
?obsrefresh.inputNames: More browser sources refreshed by the same press, in order.
?macro: Runs the steps in order, each waiting for the previous one (Companion "Sequential"); Wait delays every step after it. Red while running.
?macro.steps: Steps run in order, each waiting for the previous one; Wait delays the following ones. Up, down and remove reorder the list. Fields of each step: overlay, slot number (1 = first), field and value, Timer operation, OBS scene name, stored scene name, Wait milliseconds; Show all and Hide all can reach more control apps.
?panic: Aborts every running macro, trigger delay, Auto Close and queued key action (Companion "Abort all button and trigger runs"), then Hide All. Edits being typed are saved, not dropped.
?panic.token: Optional. With a token, Panic acts only on that control app; empty, on every control app registered on the settings page and every one open now.
?restore: Shows again the overlays that were on air at the last Panic. The set lives in memory: a plugin restart forgets it.
?restore.token: Optional. With a token, only that control app; empty, every control app that the last Panic hid.
?snapshot: Scene memory: Store saves visibility, current slot and content of every overlay; Recall applies it, except the overlays marked recall safe.
?snapshot.name: Name of the stored scene.
?snapshot.operation: "Recall" applies the scene; "Store" saves the current state (visibility, slot and content of every overlay), replacing the previous one.
?snapshot.delete: Deletes the stored scene, which may hold personal data (names).
?shift: Hold: Slot Wheel and Dial Value knobs use their optional Shift overlay or field. Red while held.
?clock: Writes a clock in a text field. Functions as in vMix (Start, Pause/Resume, Suspend, Stop and reset, Set, Change, Adjust); looks and wrap-up colors as in stagetimer. On a knob: turn = adjust, press = the function.
?clock.fieldComposite: Text field where the clock is written every second.
?clock.mode: "Countdown" counts down; "Count up" counts up; "Time of day" shows the time and starts by itself; "Until finish time" counts to the finish time.
?clock.duration: Duration for Countdown and Count up.
?clock.format: How the time appears: minutes:seconds, hours:minutes:seconds or seconds only.
?clock.operation: Function of the press, as in vMix: Pause/Resume, Start, Pause only, Stop and reset, Set duration, Change time, Add/subtract seconds.
?clock.value: Value used by Set and Change (hh:mm:ss) or by Adjust (± seconds).
?clock.yellowAt: Time left at which the key turns yellow (stagetimer colors).
?clock.redAt: Time left at which the key turns red (stagetimer colors).
?clock.overtime: Keep counting past zero (overtime) or stop at zero.
?clock.overtimeSign: Overtime with a negative (−0:01) or positive (+0:01) sign.
?clock.flash: How many times the key flashes on reaching zero.
?clock.flashField: Whether the text in the overlay flashes too.
?clock.countdownFunction: When it completes, shows or hides an overlay (by default the clock's own).
?clock.countdownTarget: Overlay shown or hidden when the clock completes.
?clock.countdownDelay: Wait before running the function, in milliseconds, up to 30 000 (30 s).
?clock.pauseOffAir: Keep counting or pause while the overlay is off air, and resume when it is back.
?clock.channel: Links a Clock on a knob to a Visor key of the same channel, which shows the time.
?clock.knobStep: Seconds added or subtracted per knob tick.
?undo: Undoes the last score change (Numeric Fields, knobs, Dial Value, Cycle, Swap, Reset); optionally only for one field.
?undo.fieldComposite: Undoes only the changes of this field. "Any field" undoes the last score change, whatever the field.
?lock: Locks or unlocks the score changes of this control app until pressed again. Red while locked.
?swap: Swaps the values of each pair of fields, e.g. team names and scores when teams change sides.
?swap.pairs: Each pair swaps values at every press (for example names and scores when the teams change sides).
?cycle: Each press sets the next value of the list (period 1, 2, extra time; possession A / B). Can stop and reset a clock.
?cycle.values: List of values. Each press writes the value after the one in the field and goes back to the first after the last; if the current value is not in the list, writes the first.
?cycle.resetClock: On advancing, stops and resets the clock of this field, also when its Clock key is not on screen.
?reset: Hold for 2 seconds to reset the fields (model reset value, else 0 or empty). Red while held.
?reset.fields: Fields that go back to the model's initial value (or 0 or empty) when the key is held for 2 s. Ctrl+click selects several.
?datasource: vMix Data Sources: selecting a row writes the mapped fields; Auto Next moves down every N seconds (red while on); file changes update the fields. On a knob: turn = choose a row (Visor), press = select it.
?datasource.definition: Chooses, creates or deletes a data source shared by every key.
?datasource.def.kind: Typed list, text file (one line per record) or CSV.
?datasource.def.path: Full path of the file on this computer (UTF-8, up to 10 MB).
?datasource.def.header: CSV option: the first row holds the column names.
?datasource.def.delimiter: CSV option: the character between columns.
?datasource.def.map: Which field receives which column. "Auto" uses the column with the same name, or the order of the fields; the row can be fixed or the selected one; the format uses {0} for the value.
?datasource.def.seconds: Interval of the automatic advance (Auto Next).
?datasource.def.loop: What happens after the last row: stop, or jump back to the first.
?datasource.operation: Next row, previous row, select a row, or turn Auto Next on and off.
?template: Writes a text built from other fields: {Overlay::Field} is replaced by that field's current value.
?template.fieldComposite: Field where the built text is written.
?template.text: Template with {Overlay::Field}, replaced by the current value of that field.
?template.insert: Inserts the reference of a field into the text.
?vote: Adds one vote to the option (a knob adds or removes one per tick). Total and percentages of the poll follow automatically. Undo, Lock and Reset work on votes.
?vote.definition: Chooses, creates or deletes a poll shared by every key.
?vote.def.options: For each option, the field that counts the votes and, optionally, the field of its percentage.
?vote.def.total: Field that receives the total of votes.
?goal: Streamlabs goal: Start writes title, goal and starting amount; Add sums the amount (not after End After or End); percentage follows. Red while the goal is active.
?goal.definition: Chooses, creates or deletes a goal shared by every key.
?goal.def.title: Data of the goal, as in Streamlabs; they do not change after it starts.
?goal.def.end: Date and time after which the goal accepts no more amounts.
?goal.def.titleField: Field where the title is written in the overlay.
?goal.def.goalField: Field where the goal amount is written.
?goal.def.percent: Field where the percentage is written.
?goal.def.reachedFunction: Action when the goal is reached: show or hide an overlay.
?goal.def.reachedTarget: Overlay shown or hidden when the goal is reached.
?goal.def.reachedDelay: Wait before running the function, in milliseconds, up to 30 000 (30 s).
?goal.operation: Add the amount, start or end the goal.
?goal.amount: Amount added per press (on a knob, per tick).
?status: Companion-style status of every UNO control app in use (also of keys not on screen) and OBS: green OK, yellow warning (near the daily API cap), red error, gray nothing configured. Shows today's App API calls; press to test the connections.
?status.connections: Each control app and OBS, with its state.
?status.test: Tests now each control app in use and OBS.
?status.apiCap: Daily limit of calls (uno free plan: 10 000). Turns yellow from 90%. 0 turns the warning off.
?status.log: Record of the last actions, without tokens; Clear log erases it.
?status.backup: Exports or imports the shared settings. Secrets go in only if checked; on import, the token fills the items that come without one.
?lockdesk: Tap to lock every UNO Overlays key and knob (they only show an alert). While locked, hold this key 2 s to unlock. Red while locked.
?lockdesk.lockAfter: Locks by itself after this time without use. 0 turns it off. Applies to every Lock Desk key.
?settings.language: Language of the keys, the inspectors and this page. "Automatic" follows the language of OpenDeck; Italian is chosen only here, because OpenDeck does not offer it.
?settings.obs: Turns on the connection to OBS used by every key.
?settings.host: Address of the OBS WebSocket server (127.0.0.1 when OBS runs on this computer).
?settings.port: Port of the OBS WebSocket server (default 4455), in OBS: Tools → WebSocket Server Settings.
?settings.password: Password of the OBS WebSocket server. Leave empty to keep the saved one; it is never shown again.
?settings.liveEditDelay: While an overlay is on air, an edit is sent only after this pause without changes, in milliseconds (0 to 10 000; 1000 by default). An Overlay key can set its own value.
?settings.apps: Control apps known to the plugin, by id (never the token). Give them a name to recognize them; removing one stops triggers, groups, Status and Panic from reaching it until a key with its token connects again.
?settings.addToken: Control token of a UNO Control App (? → API Description). The plugin tests it once before keeping it.
?settings.triggers: Event → show or hide an overlay after a delay (vMix style). Events: OBS scene goes to or leaves program, streaming or recording starts or stops, a UNO overlay goes on or off air. Every trigger is written to the plugin log when it fires or is ignored.
?settings.groups: An overlay is in one group at most. Time > 0 waits before the new one goes in; < 0 lets the old ones go out later (Singular logic layers).
?settings.newGroup: Name of the new exclusive group; Overlay keys choose it by this name.
?knob.slotNumber: Server slot that the gesture takes before showing. "Live / current slot" uses the current content of the overlay.
?knob.fieldComposite: Numeric field that the gesture increments or decrements.
?safety: Optional for each key: confirm with a second press, so an accidental touch does nothing.
?numericfields.scoreOptions: Optional score rules for this key; empty fields keep the usual behaviour.
?clock.wrapUp: Optional end of the clock: wrap-up colors, what happens at 0:00, flashing and an action when it completes.
?knob.ccw: What turning the knob to the left does.
?knob.cw: What turning the knob to the right does.
